games.name: TUNG TUNG PRISON RUN POLICE ESCAPE! Obby
[⛏️] Gilrock
games.desc:
Gilrock is a 2.5D mining game about hunting rare ores, from odds 1/20 to 1/2,000,000,000. The caverns are procedurally generated, meaning a fresh mine every run! Aside from just mining, you'll also find minigames and varied side-content.

⚠️ [Beta Release]
- The game is in active development with many planned changes.

🎮 [Game Features]
- Craft Pickaxes, Gears (like Speed Coils and Antimatter Bombs), paired with Consumables for you to rip apart the caverns. With more unlocks as you progress!
- Chase unfathomably rare collectibles, tracked in a 244+ item-long Compendium!
- Hybrid between manual/idle play with a built-in AFK Mode!

❓ [How to Play]
- Take the Mine Lift to the caverns.
- Mine manually, or go idle with AFK Mode.
- On PC, press [CTRL] to enable Smart Cursor.
